core.title: 33-inch Grade 1 Design Hardware 2000 Series Door Exit Devices

text.description_html:
Design Hardware 2000 Series Exit Devices

  • Hand: Non-Handed
  • Finishes: Brushed Stainless Steel, Aluminum & Dark Bronze Painted, (head and touchbar)
  • Strike: Roller strike standard
  • Deadlocking 5/8" Latchbolt: Standard
  • Dogging: Hex Key Dogging
  • Doors: 1 3/4" thick wood or metal
  • Projection: 3 1/8" Maximum
  • ANSI: Certified ANSI A156.3 Grade 1 standards
  • UL: UL Listed
  • Backset: Standard 2 3/4" backset
  • Fasteners: All mounting screws are concealed
  • Vertical Rod: Surface Vertical Rod also available
  • Fire Rated: Fire rating also available
  • ADA Compliant
  • Warranty: 3 years

    • When choosing the function of the lever / knob / trim:

    • Keyed Entry: Use when a keyed lock is needed.
    • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
    • Storeroom. Outside knob fixed. Entry by key only. Inside always unlocked.

    On the TP08, the thumpiece is Brushed Stainless Steel. It also includes a 1-1/4" mortise cylinder.

    UL 3-hour Fire Rating for A-Label Fire Doors (when chooosing this option below).

    NOTE: The Trim Levers with the Escutch (LE-08-2, LE-08A-2, and LE-02DT-2 ONLY) are also available in Oil Rubbed Bronze. The price is the same as the brushed stainless steel shown below, so if you need that finish just choose the stainless and let us know in the comments box that you need the US10B Oil Rubbed Bronze finish).

seo.description:
Design Hardware 2000 Series Exit Devices
This Grade 1  Exit Device is available in Aluminum, Brushed Stainless or Dark Bronze finish - 33 inches or 42 inches length with optional fire rating.
